projects.title: Local Projects Official Website
projects.summary: I built the entire frontend for Local Projects’ studio website, including templates, SCSS, and JavaScript, presenting its experience design work through project imagery and case studies.

projects.title: PUMA Official Website
projects.summary: My work on PUMA’s brand website combined Flash development, animation, design, and concept work, bringing product stories and campaign content into an interactive browsing experience.

projects.title: Equal Justice Initiative
projects.summary: I contributed JavaScript development using React and PixiJS to interactive exhibits at the original Legacy Museum, helping visitors explore the history of racial injustice in America.

projects.title: New Balance Official Website
projects.summary: For New Balance’s corporate website, I worked on Flash development and animation to present its products, manufacturing story, and community initiatives through interactive content.

projects.title: Chuck Close Official Website
projects.summary: For Chuck Close’s official website, I contributed Flash development to an image-focused experience where visitors could browse his work and examine individual pieces at a larger scale.

projects.title: Star in Dallas
projects.summary: I contributed JavaScript development to TNT’s Star in Dallas experience, which turned visitors and their Facebook friends into the cast of personalized opening credits.

projects.title: Brookfield Place
projects.summary: For Brookfield Place’s website, I worked on JavaScript and the CMS frontend, bringing shopping, dining, events, and visitor information together for the Lower Manhattan destination.

projects.title: Bottega Veneta Official Website
projects.summary: I contributed Flash development and animation to Bottega Veneta’s website, presenting its collections and Art of Collaboration campaign through photography, film, and editorial content.

projects.title: Eisenhower Timeline
projects.summary: I contributed JavaScript and CMS frontend development to an interactive Eisenhower history experience, connecting a visual timeline with archival material and resources for educators.

projects.title: My Motor Island Official Website
projects.summary: I contributed Flash development to My Motor Island, a virtual world that brought Road Rippers toy cars into an online setting for children to explore.

projects.title: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh
projects.summary: My work on the Daisy Eau So Fresh campaign included Flash development and animation, bringing fragrance imagery and a Facebook photo feature into its digital presentation.

projects.title: Nature Works Everywhere
projects.summary: I contributed JavaScript development to Nature Works Everywhere, The Nature Conservancy’s education website, which paired classroom resources with tools for exploring school gardens.

projects.title: NYSci Design Make Play
projects.summary: I contributed JavaScript development to NYSCI’s Design Make Play website, presenting its approach to STEM learning through case studies and resources for educators.

projects.title: PNC XMas Price Index
projects.summary: I developed JavaScript for the data display in PNC’s Christmas Price Index experience, presenting historical gift prices alongside an award-winning global gift hunt.

projects.title: Google Schemer
projects.summary: I contributed JavaScript and Flash development to Start Scheming, a Google Schemer promotional experience where visitors could create a mustache portrait from a photo.

projects.title: National Science Medals
projects.summary: I built the site’s frontend and the interactive laureate explorer for the National Science and Technology Medals Foundation, giving visitors a visual way to explore medal recipients and their achievements.
